status_reviews.researcher_notes: Sheet's recorded Status=proposed is stale by at least 3 years of documented progress. Trail: construction well underway by mid-2023 (regional gasification programme coverage); RuNews24.ru 2025-10-30 put the Andreevskaya-Bolsherechenskaya corridor at 70%+ complete; om1.ru (409327) reports GRS Ingaly commissioned with gas physically supplied, 186 connection contracts signed, 25 homes already connected; the operator's Sept-2026 monthly quality passport lists GRS Ingaly, GRS Andreevka and GRS Bolsherechenskaya as currently active/monitored stations. A GRS cannot receive and pass gas without its supply отвод being operational, so the trunk itself, not just the downstream distribution network, is judged operating. Not applying the dormancy/shelved rule -- this is active, recently-evidenced progress to completion, not stalled proposal-stage inactivity.
